title: COMMAND YOUR DAY BEFORE 7AM – PSALM 143 MORNING DECLARATION
text: Glory, glory, glory to God. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Oh, the presence of God is here already. I can feel it. I can sense it. The atmosphere is charged. Heaven is leaning in. Angels are gathering. Something is about to happen. Somebody lift your voice right now and just say, "Thank you, Jesus. Thank you, Jesus. Thank you for this moment. Thank you for this encounter. Thank you for waking me up this morning. Thank you for breath in my lungs. Thank you for blood flowing through my veins. Thank you for another opportunity to stand before your throne. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Hallelujah. Before we go any further, I want to say something to you. Wherever you are right now, however you came across this message, I want you to understand that this is not an accident. This is not coincidence. This is divine orchestration. The same God who numbers the hairs on your head. The same God who knows you're sitting down and you're rising up. The same God who is acquainted with all your ways. He arranged this moment for you. And I want to encourage you to do something. Share this message. Send it to someone. Post it on your status. Let it go forth because you might be the reason somebody's life changes today. You might be the bridge through which deliverance comes to a family. You might be the instrument God uses to shift someone's destiny. The Bible says in Romans 10 14-15, "How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? And how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? And how shall they hear without a preacher? And how shall they preach except they be sent? As it is written, how beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace and bring glad tidings of good things. You are a scent one today. You are a carrier of this word. So let it spread. Let it multiply. Let it reach the ends of the earth. Hallelujah. Now I want us to worship but not ordinary worship. I want us to worship with understanding. I want us to worship with revelation. I want us to worship with desperation because worship is not entertainment. Worship is warfare. Worship is engagement. Worship is the key that unlocks dimensions. Wherever you are, lift your hands. Open your mouth and let us magnify the King of Kings together. Father, we worship you. We worship you, oh God. There is none like you in all the earth. There is none beside you in all the heavens. You are the almighty. You are the allsufficient one. You are the self-existent one. You are the eternal one. We worship you. Shaba baba shandai robo shandela. Yes Lord, we bow before your majesty. We bow before your sovereignty. We bow before your holiness. We bow before your power. You are seated on the throne high and lifted up and the train of your robe fills the temple. Saraphim cry, holy. Cherobim cry holy. The living creatures cry holy. And we join them this morning. Holy, holy, holy. Lord God Almighty who was and who is and who is to come. We worship you. Hallelujah. You are the God who speaks and it is done. You are the God who commands and it stands fast. You are the God who creates with a word. [music] You are the God who sustains by the breath of your mouth. We worship you. We magnify you. We exalt you. We glorify you. Robocand sha. Father, we love you not for what you do but for who you are. You are good. You are faithful. You are merciful. You are gracious. Your loving kindness is better than life. Your tender mercies are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness. We worship you singing in the spirit. Laabashandai Roshande secandi. Yes, Lord. You are the [music] bright and morning star. You are the son of righteousness rising with healing in your wings. You are the daypring from on high, visiting us in our darkness, guiding our feet into the way of peace. We worship you. You are the author of life, the finisher of faith, the beginning and the end, the first and the last. We worship you. Every knee bows before you. Every tongue confesses in heaven, on earth, and under the earth. You are Lord. You are Lord. You are Lord. Hallelujah. Father, we thank you. We thank you for who you are. We thank you for what you've done. We thank you for what you are about to do. In this moment, as we engage your word, let there be transformation. Let there be revelation. Let there be liberation. Let there be restoration. We give you all the glory. We give you all the honor. We give you all the praise in Jesus mighty name. Amen. We magnify you. We exalt you. We glorify you. Robboandala Shababa Shandai. Father, we love you not for what you do but for who you are. You are good. You are faithful. You are merciful. You are gracious. Your loving kindness is better than life. Your tender mercies are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness. We worship you singing in the spirit. Labashi roandi secular shandai. Yes Lord, you are the bright and morning star. You are the son of righteousness rising with healing in your wings. You are the daypring from on high, visiting us in our darkness, guiding our feet into the way of peace. We worship you. You are the author of life, the finisher of faith, the beginning and the end, the first and the last. We worship you. Every knee bows before you. Every tongue confesses in heaven, on earth, and under the earth. You are Lord. You are Lord. You are Lord. Hallelujah. Father, we thank you. We thank you for who you are. We thank you for what you've done. We thank you for what you are about to do in this moment as we engage your word. Let there be transformation. Let there be revelation. Let there be liberation. Let there be restoration. We give you all the glory. We give you all the honor. We give you all the praise in Jesus mighty name. Amen. Robbo chandela. Hallelujah. You may be seated in the presence of the Lord. Glory to God. Now this morning, the spirit of God has placed something in my heart and I need you to pay close attention because what I'm about to share is not theory. It is not philosophy. It is kingdom strategy. It is divine intelligence. It is revelation that has the power to redefine your entire existence. The theme is this. Command your day before 7:00 a.m. Psalm 143. Morning declaration. >> [music] >> I want you to write that down. Meditate on it because embedded within this statement is a principle that can change everything. Let me take you to the scripture. Turn with me to Psalm 143. We're going to look at verses 8-10. David, the man after God's own heart, the warrior king, the psalmist, the prophet, David prays a prayer that is one of the most powerful morning prayers in all of scripture. It says in verse 8, "Cause me to hear thy loving kindness in the morning, for in thee do I trust. Cause my soul to trust in that wherein I should walk, for I lift up my soul unto thee." Verse 9, "Deliver me, oh Lord, from mine enemies. I flee unto thee to hide me." Verse 10, teach me to do thy will, for thou art my God. Thy spirit is good. Lead me into the land of uprightness. Hallelujah. Now I want you to see something. David says, "Cause me to hear thy loving kindness in the morning." In the morning, not at noon, not in the evening, not at midnight, in the morning. David understood something that many believers have not grasped. He understood that the morning is the foundation of the day. The morning sets the tone. The morning establishes the atmosphere. The morning determines the trajectory. Whatever happens in your morning will echo throughout your day. Let me say that again. Whatever happens in your morning will echo throughout your day. If you start your morning with worry, worry will follow you all day. If you start your morning with confusion, confusion will TRAIL YOU ALL DAY. If you start your morning with fear, fear will be your companion all day. But if you start your morning with the word of God, the word of God will guide you all day. If you start your morning with prayer, prayer will cover you all day. If you start your morning with worship, worship will surround you all day. If you start your morning with declaration, declaration will work for you all day. This is why the enemy is so interested in your morning. This is why there is warfare over your first hours. This is why the kingdom of darkness launches its fiercest attacks at the beginning of your day. Because whoever commands the morning commands the day. Let me give you another scripture. Go with me to Job chapter 38 12-13. This is God speaking to Job. And God asks a question that carries profound revelation. God says, "Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days and caused the daypring to know his place that it might take hold of the ends of the earth that the wicked might be shaken out of it." Did you hear that? Hast thou commanded the morning? God is revealing to Job and to us that the morning can be commanded. The morning is not passive. The morning is not neutral. The morning responds to command. And when you command the morning correctly, something happens. The day spring knows its place. The day spring is the dawn, the rising of the sun, the beginning of light. When you command your morning, you are commanding the light of your day to know its place. You are telling the sun where to shine. You are directing the favor of God where to rest. You are instructing blessing, where to locate. And notice what happens next. That the wicked might be shaken out of it. When you command your morning, the wicked are shaken out. The enemies are displaced. The works of darkness are uprooted. The seeds of the enemy are scattered. But if you don't command your morning, [music] the wicked remain. The enemy stay entrenched. The works of darkness continue. The seeds of the enemy grow. Hallelujah. This is why I titled this message, Command Your Day before 7:00 a.m. Why before 7:00 a.m.? Because there is something about the early morning hours that is pregnant with spiritual significance. The Bible shows us again and again that the most powerful encounters with God happen in the early morning. In Mark 1:35, "And in the morning rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." Jesus rose up a great while before day, before the sun, before the busyiness, before the distractions. He commanded his mourning through prayer. In Exodus 34:4, "And he hear two tables of stone like unto the first." And Moses rose up early in the morning and went up onto Mount Si, as the Lord had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone. Moses rose up early in the morning to receive the commandments of God. The Lord that would govern Israel for generations was received in the early morning. In 1st Samuel 1:1 19 and they rose up in the morning early and worshiped before the Lord and returned and came to their house to Rama and Elcana knew Hannah his wife and the Lord remembered her. Hannah rose up early in the morning and worshiped and the Lord remembered her. Her barness was broken because she commanded her morning with worship in Joshua 6:15. And it came to pass on the seventh day that they rose early about the dawning of the day and compassed the city after the same manner seven times. Only on that day they compassed the city seven times. Israel rose early at the dawning of the day and the walls of Jericho fell. The victory was won because they commanded their morning with obedience. Do you see the pattern? The early morning is not just a time. It is a strategic window. It is a prophetic gate. It is a spiritual opportunity. And the title says before 7 a.m. because before 7:00 a.m. is when most people are still sleeping. It is when the world is quiet. It is when distractions are minimal. It is when your spirit is most receptive. It is when heaven is most attentive. There is a transaction that takes place in the early morning hours that cannot take place at any other time. I prophesy to someone. The Lord is calling you to a new level of morning engagement. The Lord is saying, "I have things to show you that I cannot show you in the busyiness of the day. I have things to speak to you that I cannot speak in the noise of the afternoon. I have things to release to you that can only be released in the stillness of the early morning. Will you answer the call? Will you rise up before the sun? Will you command your morning before others wake up? Will you take authority over your day before 7:00 a.m.? Hallelujah. Now, let me go deeper. The psalm says, "Cause me to hear thy loving kindness in the morning." The Hebrew word for loving kindness is hessed. And hessed is one of the most powerful words in the Hebrew language. It speaks of covenant loyalty, unfailing love, merciful kindness, steadfast commitment. David is saying, "Lord, in the morning, let me hear your covenant. Let me hear your commitment. Let me hear your loyalty. Let me hear your unfailing love." Why does David need to hear this in the morning? Because the morning is when doubt attacks. The morning is when fear whispers. The morning is when the enemy reminds you of your problems. The morning is when anxiety rises. And David is saying, "Before doubt can speak, let me hear your loving kindness. Before fear can whisper, let me hear your faithfulness. Before the enemy can remind me of my problems, let me hear your promises. Before anxiety can rise, let me hear your peace." This is the key to commanding your day. You must hear from God before you hear from anyone or anything else. The first voice in your morning must be the voice of God. The first word in your morning must be the word of God. The first sound in your morning must be the sound of heaven. Because whatever voice you allow to speak first will set the tone for everything else. If the voice of fear speaks first, you will walk in fear all day. If the voice of the news speaks first, you will be anxious all day. If the voice of social media speaks first, you will be distracted all day. If the voice of your problem speaks first, you will be discouraged all day. But if the voice of God speaks first, you will walk in faith all day. If the voice of his word speaks first, you will be confident all day. If the voice of his spirit speaks first, you will be directed all day. If the voice of his love speaks first, you will be secure all day. Hallelujah. Let me give you another revelation from this psalm. David says, "For indeed do I trust. Cause my soul to trust in that wherein I should walk." David is asking God to direct his steps. He's asking God to show him the way. He's asking God to guide his path. But notice when he asks in the morning, David is saying, "Lord, before I walk, direct my steps. Before I move, show me the way. Before I decide, give me wisdom. Before I act, lead me." This is commanding your day. Commanding your day is not about arrogance. It is not about presumption. It is about alignment. It is about receiving divine direction before you engage the day. When you command your day, you are not telling God what to do. You are asking God what to do and then declaring it into existence. You receive the instruction, then you release the declaration. You hear the word, then you speak the word. You get the revelation then you make the proclamation. This is why prayer and declaration work together. Prayer is receiving from God. Declaration is releasing what you have received. Many people want to declare without praying. They want to proclaim without receiving. They want to speak without hearing. But true authority comes from intimacy. True power comes from connection. True declaration comes from revelation. First you hear the loving kindness. Then you speak the loving kindness. First you receive the direction. Then you declare the direction. First you encounter God. Then you command your day. Hallelujah. Are you still with me? Let me show you verse 9. David says, "Deliver me, oh Lord, from mine enemies. I flee unto thee to hide me." This is the warfare dimension of commanding your day. David acknowledges that there are enemies. There are forces that are against him. There are powers that want to destroy him. There are agendas that seek his downfall. And David's strategy is twofold. First, he asks for deliverance. Second, he flees to God to hide. When you command your day before 7:00 a.m., you are doing both. You are asking God to deliver you from every enemy attack that has been planned for your day and you are hiding yourself in God so that no weapon can reach you. Listen to me carefully. The enemy plans. The Bible says in Psalm 2:es 1-3, "Why do the heathen rage and the people imagine a vain thing? The kings of the earth set themselves and the rulers take counsel together against the Lord and against his anointed saying, "Let us break their bands asunder and cast away their cords from us." The enemy holds councils. The enemy makes plans. The enemy strategizes. And many of those plans are made in the night season. While you are sleeping, wickedness is planning. While you are resting, darkness is scheming. While you are unconscious, hell is plotting. But when you rise before 700 a.m. and command your day, you are disrupting the enemy's plans. You are scattering the enemy schemes. You are dismantling the enemy's strategies. Every plan that was made against you in the night is exposed by the light of your morning prayer. Every scheme that was formed against you in darkness is destroyed by the fire of your morning worship. Every plot that was devised against you by wickedness is cancelled by the power of your morning declaration. Hallelujah. I feel the Holy Ghost shabom shandai robo chandela. Now verse 10 says teach me to do thy will for thou art my God, thy spirit is good. Lead me into the land of uprightness. This is the submission dimension of commanding your day. David says, "Teach me to do thy will." Commanding your day is not about imposing your will on the universe. It is about aligning your will with God's will and then releasing God's will into your day. Many people misunderstand spiritual authority. They think authority means they can declare whatever they want and it will happen. But true authority operates within divine alignment. Jesus said in John 5:30, "I can of mine my own self do nothing. As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is just because I seek not mine will, but the will of the Father which had sent me." Even Jesus did not operate according to his own will. He operated according to the father's will. And because he was aligned with the father, everything he declared came to pass. When you command your day, you are not saying my will be done. You are saying thy will be done. You are not imposing your agenda. You are implementing God's agenda. You are not declaring your desires. You are declaring God's word. And when your declarations align with God's will, they carry the full weight of heaven's authority. Angels respond. Circumstances shift. Doors open. Enemies scatter. breakthroughs manifest because you are not speaking from yourself. You are speaking from the throne. Hallelujah. Let me give you a practical framework. Now, I want to teach you how to command your day before 7:00 a.m. using Psalm 143 as a template. First, you begin with seeking God's loving kindness. You position yourself to hear from God. You open his word. You quiet your spirit. You invite the Holy Spirit to speak. You say, "Lord, cause me to hear your loving kindness. Speak to me this morning. What do you want to say to me? What do you want to show me? What do you want to release to me?" This is the hearing phase. Second, you receive direction for your steps. You ask God to guide you. You say, "Lord, cause me to know the way wherein I should walk. Show me what to do today. Show me where to go. Show me who to talk to. Show me what to avoid. direct my steps, oh Lord. This is the receiving phase. Third, you pray for deliverance from your enemies. You identify the attacks that have been planned against you and you ask God to deliver you. You say, "Lord, deliver me from my enemies. Every trap that has been set for me, expose it. Every snare that has been laid for me, break it. Every attack that has been planned for me, cancel it. I flee to you to hide me." This is the warfare phase. Fourth, you submit to God's will and ask for his leading. You surrender your plans, your agenda, your desires to God. You say, "Lord, teach me to do your will. I don't want my way. I want your way. Lead me into the land of uprightness. Lead me into divine alignment. Lead me into kingdom purpose." This is the submission phase. And then based on all of this, you rise in authority and you command your day. You take everything you have received from God and you declare it over your day. You speak it forth. You release it into the atmosphere. You establish it in the spiritual realm. This is the command phase. Hearing, receiving, warfare, submission, command. This is the flow. This is the pattern. This is the framework. [music] And when you do this before 7:00 a.m., you are establishing the atmosphere of your day before anyone or anything else can. Hallelujah. Now I want to shift. We have taught. We have received revelation. Now it is time to engage. It is time to pray. It is time to declare. It is time to command. Everybody stand to your feet wherever you are. If you cannot stand, lift your hands but engage. This is your moment. Shabbaba komos shandanda robo chandela. Let us begin by positioning ourselves to hear God's loving kindness. Say this with me. Father in the name of Jesus, I come before your throne this morning. I come with a heart that is hungry. I come with a spirit that is thirsty. I come with a soul that is desperate. Cause me to hear your loving kindness. Speak to me, Lord. I am listening. My ears are open. My heart is receptive. My spirit is attentive. Let me hear your covenant. Let me hear your commitment. Let me hear your faithfulness. Let me hear your love. Before doubt can speak, I hear your loving kindness. Before fear can whisper, I hear your faithfulness. Before anxiety can rise, I hear your peace. Before discouragement can settle, I hear your encouragement. Your voice is the first voice I hear this morning. Your word is the first word I receive this morning. Your love is the first thing I encounter this morning. Speak Lord for your servant is listening. Shaba colos shandai. Now let us receive direction. Say this. Father cause me to know the way wherein I should walk. I lift my soul to you. I surrender my plans to you. I submit my agenda to you. Show me where to go today. Show me what to do today. Show me who to connect with today. Show me what to avoid today. Order my steps in your word. Let no iniquity have dominion over me. Lead me in the way everlasting. Lead me beside still waters. Lead me in paths of righteousness. I will not lean on my own understanding. In all my ways I acknowledge you and you direct my paths. My steps are ordered by the Lord. I walk in divine alignment. I move in kingdom purpose. I operate in heavenly timing. Every step I take today is ordained by God. Every move I make today is directed by the spirit. Every decision I make today is guided by wisdom. Hallelujah. Now let us engage in warfare. Let us pray for deliverance from our enemies. Lift your voice and say this. Father, deliver me from my enemies. Every enemy that has risen against me, I command them to fall. I take authority over every demonic assignment against my day. I cancel every satanic agenda against my morning. I break every witchcraft operation against my progress. I destroy every evil altar speaking against my destiny. I silence every oracle of darkness releasing curses over my life. Deliver me, oh Lord, from the violent man. Deliver me from those who deise mischief in their hearts. Deliver me from those who have sharpened their tongues like serpents. I flee to you to hide me. You are my refuge and my fortress. You are my hiding place. You are my shield and my buckler. Under your wings, I take refuge. In your secret place, I am hidden. No weapon formed against me shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I condemn. The enemy shall not outwit me. The wicked shall not prevail against me. The adversary shall not triumph over me. For greater is he that is in me than he that is in the world. Fire, fire, fire. Now let us submit to God's will. Say this. Father, teach me to do your will. For you are my God. I don't want my way. I want your way. I don't want my plans. I want your plans. I don't want my wisdom. I want your wisdom. Your spirit is good. Lead me into the land of uprightness. Lead me into alignment with your purpose. Lead me into fulfillment of my destiny. Lead me into manifestation of my calling. Not my will, but your will be done. Not my kingdom but your kingdom come. Not my glory but your glory be revealed. I surrender all to you. My time I surrender my talents. I surrender my resources. I surrender my relationships. I surrender my career. I surrender my ministry. I surrender. Everything I am and everything I have belongs to you. Use me for your glory. Use me for your purposes. Use me for your kingdom. I am yours, Lord. Do with me as you please. Hallelujah. Now, we rise in authority. We command our day. Lift your voice and declare. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I command this day. I speak to this morning and I say be blessed. I speak to this day and I say be fruitful. I speak to this week and I say be prosperous. I command the gates of this day to open for me. I command the doors of opportunity to swing wide. I command favor to locate me wherever I go. I command success to follow everything I touch. I command the day spring to know its place. I command the sun to shine on my path. I command the stars to align for my blessing. I command creation to cooperate with my destiny. I decree that this day is a day of victory. I decree that this day is a day of breakthrough. I decree that this day is a day of miracles. I decree that this day is a day of testimonies. No evil shall befall me today. No plague shall come near my dwelling today. No accident shall touch me today. No sickness shall infect me today. I am protected. I am preserved. I am guarded. I am kept by the blood of Jesus. I am covered by the angels of God. I am surrounded by the power of the spirit. I am strengthened by the grace of God. I am empowered. This is my day. This day belongs to me. This day was created for my advancement. This day was designed for my promotion. I take authority over every negative thing that was planned for this day. I cancel every demonic appointment. I break every evil arrangement. I scatter every wicked gathering. Nothing shall by any means harm me. Nothing shall steal my joy. Nothing shall destroy my peace. Nothing shall stop my progress. I command this day in the name of Jesus. Shandai roboandala. Yes, Lord. Fire, fire, fire. Now, I want us to pray over specific areas. This is intense warfare. Engage with everything in you. He turns shame into glory. My destiny is back on track. My purpose is being fulfilled. My calling is being manifested. Everything the enemy stole. I recover sevenfold. Robo Chandala Shaba. Let us pray for family deliverance. Father, in the name of Jesus, I cover my family with the blood of Jesus, I break every [singing] curse that has been operating in my family line. Every generational pattern of failure, I terminate it now. Every ancestral covenant with darkness, I renounce it now. Every bloodline limitation, I destroy it now. MY FATHER'S house is delivered. My mother's [music] house is delivered. My bloodline is cleansed. My lineage is purified. No more cycles of poverty in my family. No more patterns of divorce in my family. No more strongholds of addiction in my family. No more history of premature [singing] death in my family. I [music] break it. I destroy it. I terminate it. I uproot it. My family works in freedom. My family operates in blessing. My family manifest destiny. My children are mighty in the land. My children serve God with their whole hearts. My children fulfill their purpose. My children surpass my achievements. Generational blessing begins with me. Generational wealth begins with me. Generational impact begins with me. A new legacy is being written through my life. Shaba komosandi. Let us pray for marriage breakthrough. Father in the name of Jesus, I speak over my marriage. I declare that my marriage is blessed. I declare that my marriage is protected. I declare that my marriage is fruitful. Every attack a guy nst my marriage I cancel it. Every spirit of division I [clears throat] bind it. Every spirit of strife I cast it out. Every spirit of infidelity I destroy it. Every spirit of misunderstanding, I break it. Love is restored in my marriage. Intimacy is restored in my marriage. Communication is restored in my marriage. Trust is restored in my marriage. My spouse and I are one flesh. What God has joined together, no man can put us under. No devil can separate us. No witch can divide us. No circumstance can destroy us. Our marriage glorifies God. Our marriage produces godly offspring. Our marriage is a testimony of grace. For those believing for marriage, I decree divine connection. Your spouse is being prepared. Your spouse is being positioned. Your spouse is on the way. Delay is broken. Obstacles are removed. Divine timing is activated. Before this season ends, wedding bells will ring. Robbo chandela shaba. Allelujah. Let us pray for financial gates to open. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak over my finances. I command the financial gates to open. Gates of provision open now. Gates of opportunity open now. Gates of contracts open now. Gates of favor open now. Gates of increase open now. Gates of abundance open now. I break every course of poverty over my life. I break every spirit of lack. I break every pattern of struggle. I break every cycle of debt. I am blessed. I am prosperous. I am wealthy. My God supplies all my needs according to his riches in glory. The windows of heaven are open over my life. The floodgates of provision are released. Money comes to me. Resources flow to me. Wealth gravitates to me. I am a money magnet by the grace of God. [music] I am a wealth attractor by the favor of God. I am a prosperity vessel by the blessing of God. I have more than enough for my family. I have more than enough for my ministry. I have more than enough for my purpose. I finance the kingdom. I fund the gospel. I support the work of God. Generational wealth is mine. Kingdom resources are mine. Divine provision is mine. Coloshandi robo chandela fire fire. Let us pray for health and healing. Father in the name of Jesus, I speak life to my body. I declare divine health over every organ. I declare supernatural strength over every bone. I declare healing virtue over every cell. By the stripes of Jesus, I am healed. By his wounds, I am made whole. By his blood, I am cleansed. By his power, I am restored. I cause every seed of sickness. I cause every germ of disease. I cause every cancer cell. I cause every tumor. I cause every infection. I cause every virus. I cause every bacteria. I cause every inflammation die in the name of Jesus. wither in the name of Jesus. Dissolve in the name of Jesus. Disappear in the name of Jesus. My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. Sickness cannot dwell in God's temple. Disease cannot remain in God's house. I am healthy. I am whole. I am strong. I am vibrant. I shall live and not die. I shall declare the works of the Lord. Length of this is my portion. Divine health is my inheritance. Robbo chandela shaba in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. It is done. It is sealed. It is established. Amen and amen. Hallelujah.
